title: Fix binary probability scoring in out-of-bag bootstrap
body:
### Description

`bootstrap_point632_score(..., method="oob", predict_proba=True)` raises `UnboundLocalError` for binary classifiers because it converts `predicted_train_val` even though out-of-bag scoring never creates or needs training predictions.

Only convert training predictions for `.632` and `.632+`, while continuing to select the positive-class column for the out-of-bag predictions. No extra model prediction is performed.

### Validation

Base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`.

- Eight new native regression/control cases: **6 failed, 2 passed** before the fix; **8 passed** afterward.
- New tests compare all five AUC scores with an independent NumPy bootstrap and native scikit-learn fit/predict reference for three seeds and both cloning settings. Multiclass `oob` and `.632` controls verify the full probability matrix still reaches the scorer.
- `PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest mlxtend/evaluate/tests/test_bootstrap_point632.py mlxtend/evaluate/tests/test_bootstrap_oob_proba.py mlxtend/evaluate/tests/test_bootstrap_outofbag.py -q -k 'not keras'`: **22 passed, 1 deselected**. The optional TensorFlow/Keras case was not run. The existing logistic-regression tests report convergence warnings.
- Changed-file Black, isort, Flake8 and `git diff --check` passed.

Python 3.12.14, NumPy 2.3.5, scikit-learn 1.8.0. The full repository suite was not run.

### Related issues or pull requests

No existing fix was found in the repository's bootstrap/probability PR history. This is independent of #1213's `.632+` weighting and #1223's no-information-rate allocation change.

### Pull Request Checklist

- [x] Added a changelog entry.
- [x] Added regression/control tests under `mlxtend/evaluate/tests`.
- [x] Relevant tests pass and validation scope is recorded above.
- [x] Changed-file style checks pass.
